mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) over 20d periods during FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a tightening cycle that raises discount rates, reducing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) over 20d periods during FEDFUNDS above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment (PAYEMS) above 140,000 triggers a labor market expansion that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) over 5d periods during PAYEMS above 140,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the INDPRO index above 101.36 signals stronger production capacity, reducing supply-side risks and prompting equity market optimism, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) over 20d periods during sustained INDPRO increases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDPC1 (total demand) and HOUST (industrial demand) signals robust economic activity, lowering risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of GDPC1 and HOUST is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a multivariate regression predicting 60d SPX returns.

mechanism_narrative: In an expansionary labor market regime, a decline in UNRATE below 8.5% signals reduced labor cost pressures, fostering corporate profitability and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In expansionary labor markets, SPX returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE <8.5% over 20d periods.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% raises discount rates, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) over 60d periods during FEDFUNDS above 4.5% in tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both INDPRO (supply index) and RSAFS (industrial demand) signals robust production and consumption, reducing supply-side risks and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of INDPRO and RSAFS is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a multivariate regression predicting 20d SPX returns.
